learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will learn about magical describing words that paint colorful pictures of our nouns!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: An adjective is a describing word! It tells us more about a noun (a person, place, animal, or thing). It makes our sentences much more interesting.
Words that tell us the color, size, or number of something are adjectives. For example, a RED apple, TWO dogs, or a BIG elephant!
Adjectives also tell us how things look, feel, smell, or taste! Like a SWEET candy, a SOFT pillow, or a HAPPY baby.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Adjective Spy Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Pick your favorite toy. Now, be a spy and think of three adjectives to describe it! Is it fluffy, blue, and small? Tell your parents your three describing words.

quick_recap: ⭐ Adjectives are words that describe nouns.
⭐ They tell us about color, size, shape, and number.
⭐ They help us picture how something looks, feels, or tastes.
